***“The Trillion Dollar AI Bottleneck”*** *– Exploring the Technologies Powering the Next Wave of Artificial Intelligence*


WESTBOROUGH, Mass. –


Kopin Corporation (NASDAQ: KOPN), a leading provider of application-specific optical systems and high-performance microdisplays for defense, training, enterprise, industrial, consumer and medical products, invites investors, technology professionals, industry observers, and AI enthusiasts to virtually join a YouTube “Ask Me Anything” (AMA) event titled **“The Trillion Dollar AI Bottleneck”** on **October 20, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. EDT** , streamed live from **Nasdaq MarketSite.**


**Livestream Access:**[Live From NYC: The Trillion Dollar AI Bottleneck](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Flive%2FdGJkJET9tuY&esheet=54623611&newsitemid=20261016257577&lan=en-US&anchor=Live+From+NYC%3A+The+Trillion+Dollar+AI+Bottleneck&index=1&md5=4c19cb97229a62cd4a130c2c9693596d)


Participants are encouraged to virtually join the livestream and submit questions in real time as the panel explores what it will take to build the infrastructure backbone for the AI-driven economy. Questions can also be submitted in advance toevents@kopin.com .


The interactive livestream will feature a panel of distinguished thought leaders from across the AI and technology ecosystem:


- [James Altucher](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.jamesaltucher.com%2F&esheet=54623611&newsitemid=20261016257577&lan=en-US&anchor=James+Altucher&index=2&md5=6a70832a8f29f05f38701f0e890887ff) , Senior Strategic Advisor,[Fabric.AI](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ffabricai.com%2F&esheet=54623611&newsitemid=20261016257577&lan=en-US&anchor=Fabric.AI&index=3&md5=6029708ff77a4dd845fa5c4609e33e0b)


- [Cortney Harding](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcortney-harding.com%2F&esheet=54623611&newsitemid=20261016257577&lan=en-US&anchor=Cortney+Harding&index=4&md5=50213d9a69dfd739c476dc3547e6e79d) , AI and Emerging Technology Expert and Founder,[Friends with Holograms](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.friendswithholograms.com%2F&esheet=54623611&newsitemid=20261016257577&lan=en-US&anchor=Friends+with+Holograms&index=5&md5=93d44040eaa537cd5848be23f67a5b2d)


- [Michael Murray](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fin%2Fmikeamurray%2F&esheet=54623611&newsitemid=20261016257577&lan=en-US&anchor=Michael+Murray&index=6&md5=50184a98dcb9af7ba237395949b9eba2) , Chief Executive Officer, President and Chairperson,[Kopin Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.kopin.com&esheet=54623611&newsitemid=20261016257577&lan=en-US&anchor=Kopin+Corporation&index=7&md5=1d637b7ffc85cb9491d05a6d7ff13089)


As AI models grow larger and more powerful, demand for compute resources, networking, energy, and data infrastructure continues to rise. During the discussion, panelists will examine the challenges and opportunities shaping the future of AI, including data center capacity, optical interconnect technologies, infrastructure scalability, and the innovations required to sustain AI’s rapid expansion.


Unlike a traditional panel discussion, audience participation will play a central role. Viewers will be invited to submit questions live through the YouTube event, helping guide the conversation and providing direct access to the panelists’ insights on some of the industry’s most pressing topics.


“AI development is moving at extraordinary speed, but the physical infrastructure needed to support that growth presents significant challenges and opportunities,” said Michael Murray, CEO, President and Chairperson of Kopin. “This discussion will explore the technologies and investments necessary to overcome these bottlenecks and unlock the next phase of AI innovation.”


**Event Details**


**Event:** Live from NYC: The Trillion Dollar AI Bottleneck


**Format:** Live YouTube Ask Me Anything (AMA)


**Date:** October 20, 2026


**Time:** 11:00 a.m. EDT


**Location:** Nasdaq MarketSite, Times Square, New York City


**Livestream Access:**[Live From NYC: The Trillion Dollar AI Bottleneck](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Flive%2FdGJkJET9tuY&esheet=54623611&newsitemid=20261016257577&lan=en-US&anchor=Live+From+NYC%3A+The+Trillion+Dollar+AI+Bottleneck&index=8&md5=790068cfcd75713823b3ac3d0116c730)

**About Kopin**


Kopin Corporation (Nasdaq: KOPN) is a leading developer and provider of innovative display, Optical Interconnect devices and application-specific optical solutions sold as critical components and subassemblies for defense, enterprise, professional and consumer products. Kopin’s portfolio includes microdisplays, display modules, eyepiece assemblies, image projection modules and vehicle mounted and head-mounted display systems that incorporate ultra-small high-resolution Active Matrix Liquid Crystal displays (AMLCD), Ferroelectric Liquid Crystal on Silicon (FLCoS) displays, MicroLED displays (µLED) and Organic Light Emitting Diode (OLED) displays, a variety of optics and low-power ASICs and optical interconnect devices for data centers.
